how_to_apply: Go to the NIT Rourkela official website and navigate to Faculty & Staff, SRICCE, Career, and Notices sections.
Read the advertisement details carefully before filling out the form.

Complete the application form and prepare signed and scanned copies of educational qualification certificates (mark-sheets and/or certificates), research papers (if any), work experience certificate (if any), and other relevant documents.
Merge all documents into a single PDF file.
Send the completed application and signed application (soft copy) with supporting documents via email to [email protected] (with copies to [email protected]).
Mention "Advertisement No." on the subject link of the email.
Ensure the application reaches the institute on or before the last date of 25-Oct-2026. No hard copies of application(s) are required to be sent to the institute.
important_instructions: Engagement will be purely on temporary / contractual basis and co-terminus with the completion of the project. Mere possession of minimum qualification does not guarantee invitation to the interview. Candidates will be short listed based on merit and need of the project. Selection / Joining will be cancelled in case of any suppression of information / document submitted. NIT Rourkela reserves the right to fix higher criteria for short-listing of eligible candidates from those satisfying advertised qualification and requirement of the project. Any clarification required on eligibility regarding the above post, the candidate may contact in the above mentioned details. Other terms & conditions governed as per guidelines issued by the funding agency for the engagement of above position as amended from time to time shall be in force towards this temporary recruitment.

faq.question: Q1. What is NIT Rourkela Junior Research Fellow (JRF) recruitment?
faq.answer: It is a temporary project-based recruitment for 1 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position under the project titled "CHAAYANKAN: Comprehensive AI-based Geospatial Data Analytics for Tea Plantation Monitoring" at NIT Rourkela.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in NIT Rourkela JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NIT Rourkela JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the application via email is 25-Oct-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for NIT Rourkela JRF?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M. Tech / M.E. / M. Tech. [R] / M.S. [R] in Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) / IT / Equivalent with 60% marks or 6.5/10 CGPA, or B.Tech/B.E in CSE/IT with valid GATE score, or M.Sc/MCA with GATE/NET in Computer Science / IT / Equivalent.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NIT Rourkela JRF Recruitment?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 28 years, with age relaxations up to 5 years for SC/ST/PWD/Female candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates.
